source.n8n_access: read-only GET /executions only; no live execution has ever reached the poll loop (see hand-poll-completed.json). Input shaped from the GET /media/jobs/{job_id} callback body documented in the node header.
source.rationale: This is the reason the `failed` -> immediate poll (poll_wait_s: 0) exists at all in media-route: the synchronous POST response's `notices` were computed BEFORE the worker ran, so a worker-side refusal (unreadable audio, clip measured over the cap) is only on the ledger row and only the job GET carries it. The merge must therefore let `notices` through UNCHANGED on a failed job — media-route then renders notice[0].text instead of the generic fallback. `polledOk` is still true here (status is present and truthy; a non-null `error` alone does not falsify it, since the guard only fires when status AND job_id are both absent), so `error` passes through verbatim rather than being replaced by the transport string.
